sessions.title: EXPO HALL
What Is Your Business Central Data Trying to Tell You? Hosted by JourneyTeam
sessions.description: Stop reconciling spreadsheets. Start making confident decisions. Join us for a live demo of JourneyTeam Analytics for Business Central and discover how centralized reporting can help reduce duplication, minimize errors, and break down data silos - so your teams spend less time debating numbers and more time acting on insights. Powered by Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, JourneyTeam Analytics brings Business Central data into a trusted reporting foundation with consistent definitions across teams. Explore ready-to-use reporting packs for sales, finance, inventory, and purchasing, and see how business users can uncover trends and answer questions with less dependence on IT and custom builds. Start with the insights you need today, simplify setup with a proven framework, and expand as your business grows. Stop by to see how a scalable, AI-ready foundation can bring greater clarity to your reporting - and help your teams move from disconnected data to shared understanding. Transform the way you use data – drive smarter decision, faster with JourneyTeam Analytics for Business Central.

sessions.title: Business Central AI Agents in Action
sessions.description: See how Business Central’s Sales Order Agent and Payables Agent help streamline everyday processes. The Sales Order Agent can interpret customer emails, create or update quotes and orders, and generate tailored responses — reducing manual data entry and speeding up sales cycles. The Payables Agent automatically captures vendor invoices, helping classify invoice lines - cutting down processing time and minimizing errors. Join this session to explore how these AI agents simplify core business workflows and bring immediate productivity gains to your organization.

sessions.title: Coaching for customer service representatives
sessions.description: Configure and operate coaching for Dynamics 365 Customer Service

sessions.title: From AI Experiment to Agent Supervisor: Rethinking the Digital Sales Role
sessions.description: What changes when supervising an AI agent becomes part of the sales role? Hear directly from customers about the journey from experimenting with Sales Qualification Agent to making agent supervision part of everyday account management. Join Dynamics 365 FastTrack to explore the organizational decisions behind that shift: what people need to learn, how responsibilities change, and where human oversight belongs. Discuss how sales leadership, enablement, and implementation teams can support a new way of working without losing accountability for customer relationships.

sessions.title: From Customer Data to Customer Engagement: Bringing CI-Data and CI-Journeys Together
sessions.description: Many Customer Insights implementations start from one of two directions: bringing fragmented customer data together to build a better understanding of the customer or orchestrating personalised engagement across the customer lifecycle. The real opportunity comes when these two capabilities are designed together. In this session, we’ll explore the end-to-end story across Customer Insights – Data and Customer Insights – Journeys, from turning customer data into meaningful profiles and insights, through to using that intelligence to shape audiences and customer engagement. We’ll use practical scenarios to discuss the key solution design decisions across the lifecycle: what data should come into Customer Insights, what needs to be unified or enriched, what information should drive segmentation and engagement, and how changes in customer data can translate into relevant, timely journeys. We’ll also showcase how first-party agents can assist marketers across this lifecycle. Along the way, we’ll share practical implementation considerations and lessons from real-world Customer Insights engagements, including where teams can get more value by treating CI-Data and CI-Journeys as one connected solution rather than two separate implementations.

sessions.title: HSO Fireside Chat | Beyond the Implementation: Building a Partnership for Continuous Transformation
sessions.description: Join us for a candid conversation between Mott MacDonald and HSO tracing the evolution of the partnership, from CRM into client relationships, data, AI, and Mott MacDonald's broader transformation roadmap. Transformation rarely happens through a single implementation. In this fireside conversation, leaders from Mott MacDonald and HSO share how an initial CRM initiative evolved into a broader, long-term transformation partnership spanning client relationship management, data, AI, and future modernization. Rather than focusing solely on technology, the conversation explores the business and leadership decisions behind the transformation, the data investments and organizational shifts that let Mott MacDonald expand an initial CRM initiative into a broader modernization strategy, how a strong data foundation is creating new opportunities for AI, and what comes next. Attendees will hear an honest customer perspective on what it takes to move beyond individual technology projects and create a foundation for continuous transformation.

sessions.title: Managing Humans and AI Together: The Future of Workforce Engagement Management
sessions.description: This session will explore how Workforce Engagement Management is evolving into the operating system for modern service operations. We will look at how forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, intraday management, quality, compliance, and coaching come together—and how WEM must now manage human and AI capacity as one workforce.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Dynamics 365 Field Service Latest Innovations
sessions.description: An overview of the newest Field Service capabilities across scheduling, mobile, and AI assistance. See what's shipping now and what's coming next.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Latest Innovations
sessions.description: A rapid demo tour of the newest Supply Chain Management capabilities across planning, warehouse, and manufacturing. Leave with a prioritized list of what to adopt next.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Latest innovations in Dynamics 365 Warehouse Management and preview of roadmap
sessions.description: In this session, we will explore how Microsoft is transforming warehouse operations through advanced automation, intelligence, and user productivity. You'll learn about groundbreaking capabilities such as dynamic inventory on-hand balancing, which leverages demand forecasting to continuously align inventory levels with expected demand; advanced picking route optimization, using coordinate-based warehouse layouts and sophisticated optimization algorithms to reduce travel time and improve fulfillment efficiency; and Power Fx-powered intelligent formulas that enable real-time prioritization and orchestration of warehouse work without the need for custom code. We will also showcase new productivity enhancements, including media capture capabilities that allow users to attach photos and videos directly to business processes and data records throughout Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, improving visibility, collaboration, and issue resolution across warehouse operations. Whether you're a warehouse manager, supply chain leader, implementation partner, or technology professional, this session will provide valuable insights into where warehouse management is heading and how Microsoft's latest investments can help organizations increase efficiency, agility, and operational excellence.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: What’s New in Dynamics 365 ERP MCP
sessions.description: A tour of the newest MCP capabilities that let agents and apps act on ERP business processes safely. See what's available now and what's next.

sessions.title: Optimize your Dynamics 365 implementation with Project Optimize
sessions.description: Improve core customer service metrics and automate mining skills and improvement patterns

sessions.title: Revolutionizing Finance: Harnessing the Latest Innovations for Competitive Advantage
sessions.description: Join Marco Smiths, Principal GBB for Finance at Microsoft, and Lone Gru, MVP and Finance Viking at Arineo as we explore the the newest innovations transforming the finance landscape. In this session, we will explore how technologies such as AI, automation, and data analytics are reshaping financial processes. Discover how these advancements are not only streamlining operations but also empowering finance teams to make smarter, faster decisions. Learn practical strategies and real-world examples of how customers and partners can leverage these innovations to drive operational efficiency, enhance financial accuracy, and unlock new growth opportunities. Whether you're looking to modernize legacy systems, improve compliance, or gain more strategic insights, this session will provide valuable perspectives on harnessing technology to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving landscape. Don't miss this opportunity to gain expert insights and actionable ideas for transforming your finance functions with the newest innovations!

sessions.title: Service Agent: From Configuration to Extensibility Across Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365
sessions.description: Empowering service professionals with AI starts with bringing intelligent assistance directly into the tools they use every day. In this hands-on lab, you'll learn how to configure and extend Service Agent across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Dynamics 365 Customer Service workspace, and Outlook. You'll explore how Service Agent brings AI-powered customer service capabilities into familiar workflows, helping service professionals access customer information, work with cases, and improve productivity across applications. Through guided exercises, attendees will gain practical experience setting up Service Agent, enabling available experiences across Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365, and exploring how the agent can be tailored to meet business-specific requirements. We'll demonstrate how to use Maker Mode to customize Service Agent, explore extensibility through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and external capabilities, and understand how to build upon the out-of-box experience without starting from scratch. Attendees will see practical examples of extending Service Agent to connect with business systems, access additional information, and support organization-specific service workflows. By the end of the session, you'll understand how to configure, customize, and extend Service Agent to deliver a more connected and intelligent customer service experience across Microsoft applications.

sessions.title: Should your Agent have a Budget?
sessions.description: Microsoft licensing has kept us confused since the big bang. The "Age of AI" didn't fix that, it fractured it further. Consumption meters on Copilot Cowork, Work IQ API pricing, Copilot Studio message packs, Dataverse capacity, model choices and licensing as a foundation. All are split across multiple platforms and ownership. And somewhere in that mess, your agents are quietly spending real money on real cloud services, borrowing human credentials, and answering to no one. Only until your CFO asks what the fleet cost last month, what it paid back in value, and why nobody caught that token-consumption monster of an agent before it hit production. If any of those made you uncomfortable, this session is for you. We'll open up the architecture of a productive agent and follow the money - through the cost streams AI adoption quietly drags along, the ones that shape your unit economics long before a user ever sees the agent. Let's answer the uncomfortable questions and close the gaps without slowing adoption and business down.

sessions.title: Stop Reporting in Spreadsheets: Unlock Financial Insights in Business Central
sessions.description: Many organizations still rely heavily on spreadsheets to prepare financial reports, consolidate data, and analyze business performance. While familiar, spreadsheet-based reporting often results in manual effort, version control challenges, delayed insights, and increased risk of errors. In this session, discover how Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central can help you move beyond spreadsheets and transform your financial reporting process. Learn how to leverage built-in financial reporting tools, dimensions, account schedules, analysis views, and Power BI integration to access accurate, real-time financial data directly from your ERP system. We will demonstrate practical approaches to creating dynamic financial statements, department and project profitability reports, budget-to-actual comparisons, and executive dashboards without the need for complex spreadsheet models. Whether you're a finance leader, controller, accountant, or Business Central user, this session will provide actionable strategies to improve reporting efficiency, enhance data accuracy, and enable faster decision-making.

sessions.title: Transform your organization: Coaching Made Simple
sessions.description: Simply put, time spent coaching is the most valuable investment a leader can make with their time. Most leaders are not truly prioritizing their role as Coach, even though they are aware that they should be helping their direct reports improve over time. This workshop provides a simple framework that demystifies coaching and inspires leaders to transform their leadership by becoming a great coach.

sessions.title: Whats new in 2027 for Microsoft Global Skilling (MS Learn) and Microsoft Certified Trainers (MCTs)
sessions.description: Microsoft is making huge directional shifts with Global Skilling (MS Learn) and the Microsoft Certified Trainer (MCT) program in 2027. In this session, come listen to Microsoft, a Microsoft MVP, and the longest tenured Microsoft Certified Trainers (MCT) about what 2027 has in store for the community. AI and more interactive media strategies are going to revolutionize how people will learn and stay up to date on the latest technologies. This session will reveal new announcements as well as the new changes to the MCT program works and how you can take steps to build an MCT training program within your organization.

sessions.title: Hummingbird Presents: Women in Tech Luncheon
sessions.description: A space to hear from industry professionals in a panel conversation that will be intentional, authentic, and uniquely voiced.

sessions.title: LUNCH BREAK
After the Acquisition: Rebuilding a Unified ERP and Field Service Platform Across Multiple Entities
sessions.description: Businesses built from the acqusition of multiple compagnies often inherits a plethora of different systems, which most of the time include legacy products and homemade solutions. Assessing objectively the current state and defining a technology roadmap addressing both the present and future operations can be a tedious task that easily take a wrong turn. This session follows the technology journey of such a client, from the assessment of its technology and processes, to the design of its roadmap, to the migration and an implemention of new ERPs and Field Service systems. It will highlight business and technology pain points, risks, solutions, implementation and upcoming growth.

sessions.title: Agent Ready: Building the Dataverse Foundation for AI-Powered Sales
sessions.description: AI Agents promise to transform how sellers work—but agents are only as effective as the data they can discover, understand, and trust. Before organizations deploy Dynamics 365 Sales Agents, Copilot experiences, and conversational AI, they need to build an agent-ready data foundation. In this session, we'll explore the Dataverse capabilities that power modern AI experiences, including Dataverse Search, semantic understanding of business data, security trimming, relationship modeling, and data quality practices. You'll learn why some AI deployments deliver extraordinary value while others struggle with hallucinations, incomplete results, and low user trust. Through technical demonstrations and real-world architecture guidance, discover how to prepare Dynamics 365 and Dataverse environments for the next generation of AI-powered business applications. Attendees will leave with a practical framework for assessing whether their organization is truly ready for Copilots, Agents, and the future of autonomous business processes.

sessions.title: DO NOT SUBMIT FOR UPDATES UNTIL SEP 1 - Why Enterprise Agents Fail; and the Microsoft Answer
sessions.description: DO NOT SUBMIT FOR UPDATES UNTIL SEP 1 - Enterprise agents fail at alarming rates in production, despite rapid advances in foundation models - not because the models are weak, but because they lack business context, organizational awareness, and governance guardrails. This flagship session unpacks why, REMOVED. Bobby can comment

sessions.title: Dynamics 365 Activate: An accelerated implementation journey to Dynamics Finance & Operations Apps
sessions.description: Join Dynamics 365 FastTrack to learn more about Dynamics 365 Activate to support a streamlined automated migration to Dynamics 365. Hear directly from early adopters about their experiences, lessons learned and efficiences gained. Discover how agents are optimizing migrations and reducing time to value for Dynamics 365 customers.

sessions.title: How Agentic AI Is Transforming Customer Support
sessions.description: Customer expectations are rising while service teams face increasing complexity, growing case volumes, and pressure to do more with less. In this session, discover how Dynamics 365 Customer Service is ushering in a new era of Agentic Customer Service with a team of AI agents that work together to transform every stage of the service journey. Learn how the Customer Intent Agent understands and classifies customer needs, the Case Management Agent automates resolution workflows, the Knowledge Management Agent continuously creates and improves organizational knowledge, and the Quality Evaluation Agent measures and elevates service performance at scale. Together, these agents help organizations move beyond traditional productivity gains toward intelligent, autonomous service operations that accelerate resolution, improve customer satisfaction, and empower human agents to focus on higher-value work.

sessions.title: Making Every Agent Your Best Agent with Real-Time Human Assist
sessions.description: Every service organization has top-performing agents, but the goal is to make that level of expertise available to everyone. This session shows how real-time Human Assist can help agents resolve issues faster with contextual knowledge, guided actions, case summarization, suggested responses, and expert consultation. We will focus on how Human Assist improves consistency, reduces ramp time, and helps agents handle complex customer moments with confidence.

sessions.title: Managing the Hybrid Workforce: Supervisors for Human and AI Agents
sessions.description: Supervisors are no longer managing only queues and human agents; they are managing a hybrid workforce of people, copilots, and autonomous agents. This session introduces the emerging supervisor experience for monitoring performance, quality, coaching, analytics, escalations, consults, and workload across human and AI agents. We will discuss how service leaders can gain visibility into AI-driven work, intervene when needed, and coach teams based on real-time operational insights.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Dynamics 365 Commerce Innovations and Commerce MCP
sessions.description: A live tour of the newest Commerce capabilities across channels, store, and digital. See what's shipping now and what's on the roadmap.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Dynamics 365 Innovations in end-2-end Rental Management and Asset-as-a-Service
sessions.description: Learn how Dynamics 365 supports end-to-end rental management and asset-as-a-service solution from quote to contract, reservation management, equipment movement, maintenance and field service, to billing and invoicing.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Dynamics 365 Project Operations — From -12 to +12: What's New and What's Next
sessions.description: Twelve months ago, where were we? Twelve months from now, where will we be? Join us for a fast-paced tour of the newest capabilities in Dynamics 365 Project Operations and an insider's look at the innovations shaping the future of project-based businesses. We'll highlight the capabilities that have recently shipped across project planning, resource management, financials, AI-powered experiences, and project-to-cash processes, and offer a preview of what's coming next.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Get more done in Dynamics 365 ERP with Copilot Cowork
sessions.description: See Copilot Cowork take on multi-step ERP work across apps, documents, and data. Leave knowing which of your team's recurring tasks it can pick up first.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: The Future of Finance: Multi-Ledger and the Next Generation of Cost Accounting
sessions.description: Explore how multi-ledger and modern cost accounting let you report multiple truths from one source of data. See where the capability stands today and where it's headed.

sessions.title: Microsoft Roundtable: Agentic Transformation in Action: Share Your Dynamics 365 ERP Story
sessions.description: Every transformation journey is different. In this interactive roundtable, join fellow Dynamics 365 customers to share what’s working, what you’ve learned, and where you’re headed next. We’ll explore the experiences, decisions, and lessons shaping transformation across organizations, while creating opportunities to connect great stories with the broader Dynamics community. Come ready to participate, exchange ideas, and learn from others on the journey.

sessions.title: Reimagining Customer Engagement with Project Tahoe
sessions.description: What if every account manager, customer success professional, partner manager, and product expert had an AI teammate working alongside them 24x7? In this session, discover Project Tahoe, Microsoft's vision for a service AI teammate that operates directly within Outlook, Teams, and Microsoft 365. Learn how Tahoe is onboarded like an employee, grounded in business knowledge, trained on organizational practices, and empowered to handle customer inquiries, draft responses, manage follow-ups, and continuously improve through feedback. See how Tahoe helps organizations increase responsiveness, reduce burnout, preserve expertise, and ensure customers receive consistent, high-quality engagement at scale.

sessions.title: Responsible AI in Business Central: Data Boundaries, Governance, and Trust for SMB Deployments
sessions.description: Everyone wants to turn on Copilot. Far fewer can answer where their data actually goes when they do, or who's accountable when an agent gets something wrong. This session tackles the governance work that mid-market teams tend to skip because they don't have a dedicated compliance function to do it for them. I'll walk through the practical guardrails I put in place on real Business Central deployments: how to reason about data boundaries and what stays inside your tenant, how to set user-level and role-based controls so Copilot only sees what it should, how to audit and review AI-generated output before it hits your books, and how to build enough trust that people actually use the tools instead of quietly working around them.

sessions.title: BREAK
Architecting the AI-Enabled Enterprise: SBA Communications’ Dynamics 365 Transformation
sessions.description: SBA Communications, a global multibillion-dollar enterprise with more than 120 legal entities, is undertaking a multi-year digital transformation centered on Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations. Drawing on this active enterprise transformation, SBA Communications and Crowe will share how enterprise architecture is being used to connect Dynamics 365, an Azure-based Enterprise Integration Platform, an Enterprise Data Platform, Power Platform, Azure services, and AI into a coordinated transformation and operating model. The session will show how AI is being applied in two complementary ways. First, AI is improving implementation efficiency across architecture, requirements analysis, development, integration design, data mapping, documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and defect analysis. Second, the program is establishing the architecture, data, integration, governance, and security foundations needed to embed AI into enterprise tools, workflows, applications, and business processes. Speakers will share practical lessons on scaling AI responsibly while maintaining human accountability, engineering quality, and enterprise controls. Attendees will leave with actionable patterns for reducing integration complexity, governing enterprise data, embedding AI into delivery practices, and preparing a large Dynamics 365 environment for broader organizational AI adoption.

sessions.title: Business Central: Core Functionalities Overview including agentic and AI capabilities
sessions.description: Gain a deep understanding of Business Central’s features and UI for streamlining daily operations and boosting productivity. Finance, sales, purchasing, manufacturing, warehousing, projects, service management, e-commerce, AI and agents.

sessions.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central and Dynamics 365 Sales Customer Success Stories
sessions.description: Customers are now benefiting from switching from other CRM solutions such as Zoho and Salesforce and moving to Dynamics 365 Sales coupled with Dynamics 365 Business Central. In this session, we will cover three real customer use cases, where customers migrated to Dynamics 365 Sales in conjunction with Business Central to create sales and operational efficiency and save hundreds of thousands of dollars in licensing and integration costs.

sessions.title: Equipment Rental 101. From Generators to Cranes
sessions.description: With Microsoft expanding rental capabilities in Dynamics 365, understanding the rental industry is becoming essential. In this session, I like to introduce the fundamentals of equipment rental, focusing on assets such as generators, pumps, cranes, heavy equipment, etc... Learn how rental differs from traditional sales, explore key models (short-term, long-term, project-based), and understand core processes like quotation, planning, delivery, billing, and returns. I will also cover industry-specific challenges such as asset availability, utilization, and damage tracking. Ideal for partners and consultants looking to build foundational rental knowledge.

sessions.title: From Foundation to Frontier: Scaling Dataverse for the Agentic Enterprise
sessions.description: Dataverse is no longer just your data layer. It's the grounding layer for every AI capability your organisation deploys. Agents query it, act on it, and make decisions from it. Copilot generates from it. The architectural decisions made before and during growth now determine not just platform performance — but whether your AI and agent investments succeed or hallucinate. This session brings a perspective Microsoft can't: field experience spanning Dataverse from its earliest days to the agentic enterprise it now underpins. Between us, we've watched this platform evolve across dozens of enterprise implementations — the patterns that scale, the shortcuts that become technical debt, and the architectural crossroads organisations consistently underestimate until it's too late. Through a structured dialogue between a technical solution architect and a delivery leader — 30+ years of combined Dynamics 365 and Power Platform experience — we pair strategic frameworks with practical technical guidance. Not just the "what" but the "why," the "when," and the "what we've seen go wrong." Designed for organisations at an inflection point: initial implementations have proven platform value, and the next phase requires more deliberate architectural choices. Attendees leave with a practical decision framework grounded in real-world field constraints — the kind that only comes from having been there since the beginning. No theory. No product roadmap. Just lessons from the field.

sessions.title: From Pilot to Production: Scaling AI in the Contact Center
sessions.description: Many organizations can launch an AI pilot, but scaling it into a reliable production contact center experience is much harder. This session examines the architecture, governance, operational readiness, data foundations, and change-management practices required to move AI from experiment to enterprise deployment. Attendees will learn common failure points, practical scale patterns, and how to prepare teams for production-grade AI service operations.

sessions.title: Goodwill, Feeding America, and the Case for ERP
sessions.description: Nonprofits face the same ERP complexity as any retail or distribution business, including inventory, POS, supply chain, and reporting, but with constraints most Dynamics 365 case studies never touch: every dollar is scrutinized by a board focused on program spending, staff often resist anything that feels "corporate," and donor and grant reporting requirements add a layer of accountability commercial companies don't carry. This session brings together leaders from Goodwill and Feeding America who are running Dynamics 365, at different stages, through exactly these pressures. Goodwill will share what's working now that the system is live: how it got mission-driven staff to adopt it, how it's using Dynamics 365 to meet donor transparency requirements without drowning in manual reporting, and how it made the business case to a board that measures success in meals served or people employed, not margin. Feeding America will share the view from the other side, including what it's taking to get a system like this live in the first place, as it rolls it out to food banks across the country, and what its leaders are learning along the way. Attendees will hear directly from both organizations, at both ends of the journey: what it looks like once it's working, and what it looks like while you're still building it.

sessions.title: Making Change Management Real: How Southeast Toyota Connects Process, People, and Adoption for AI
sessions.description: Southeast Toyota is in the middle of a major modernization effort tied to its Dynamics 365/AI transformation. But the challenge is not just implementing new technology; it is helping the business understand how work will change, who will be impacted, and how teams can prepare for a future operating model and AI incorporation. In this customer case session, Southeast Toyota will share its change management journey and how process visibility is helping make transformation impact easier to see, explain, and act on. The discussion will explore how Southeast Toyota connects current-state processes, future-state design, roles, systems, and business ownership so change management is grounded in the real work people do every day. Mavim and Microsoft will join the session to support the story and demonstrate Southeast Toyota's Change Management Dashboard, showing how change impact can be visualized across processes, teams, roles, and systems. Attendees will see how Southeast Toyota is using this approach to support stakeholder conversations, focus readiness efforts, reduce confusion, and create a more practical path to adoption throughout the Dynamics 365/AI transformation.

sessions.title: Managing Usage Costs and Other Hidden Costs of D365 at Scale
sessions.description: The license quote is the down payment, not the total cost of ownership. Dynamics 365 is similar to purchasing a car, there are both purchasing and run costs. The costs that actually decide your Dynamics 365 run-rate may not be clear during the demo. As a Microsoft MVP, I walk leaders through the full cost of running Dynamics 365, not just the software. In this session I'll show you my TCO tool, run live scenarios, and walk through each cost and which levers you have to control it. We'll cover four costs, starting with the ones that reach IT as an invoice and moving to the ones that never appear as a line item. Usage costs are the new worry for everyone: Copilot message packs, Power Platform request entitlements, and storage that compounds quietly. We'll understand each one and watch where these accrue in the model. Maintenance is next: extensions, integrations, and the twice-yearly update cycle. Real value, and a real regression tax. Data hygiene is the silent one. It turns your data estate into debt instead of value, inflates storage bills, and degrades every AI feature and agent you build on top of it. Then the ceiling: service protection limits and the 429s that, left unhandled, at best slow you down, at worst drop messages. You'll leave with a model you can use to forecast and defend the true cost of running D365.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Build and extend Workforce Management with HR, Business Skills, MCP
sessions.description: Learn how Dynamics 365 HR, business skills, and the MCP server help customers and partners build and extend workforce management solutions.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Connecting Projects, Products, and Profit with Dynamics 365 Project Operations
sessions.description: Projects don't operate in isolation—and neither should your systems. Join the Dynamics 365 Project Operations team to see how the modern Project Operations architecture is creating a seamless connection between project delivery, Finance, and Supply Chain Management. Through live demonstrations, we'll showcase new capabilities for stocked product scenarios, enhanced material and inventory processes, and subscription billing experiences that help organizations manage both project-based and recurring revenue streams. Learn how these innovations eliminate operational silos, simplify project-to-cash processes, and enable a more connected business platform from planning through fulfillment and billing.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Finance for Service and Product-Led Organizations
sessions.description: See an overview of how frontier firms are operating their product and service led organizations. This session is meant to inspire and educate you and allow you to see deeper focus on other sessions.

sessions.title: Microsoft Roundtable: Analytics, Data Platform
sessions.description: Join an interactive discussion on turning ERP data into trusted insights and action, while ensuring your application scales and your database stays manageable as your data grows.

sessions.title: Proving Contact Center Readiness at Scale: Dynamics 365 Benchmark Best Practices for AI Voice
sessions.description: Moving a large contact center to AI-powered voice raises one question: will it hold up when thousands of customers call at once? Enterprise contact centers can't take AI-powered voice live on hope. This session shares best practices from production-scale Dynamics 365 Contact Center performance benchmarking. We'll cover how to define acceptance criteria, model realistic call workloads, ramp safely with stop gates, and measure the customer's real experience. We'll also show how to find true bottlenecks across dependent services and separate platform limits from test artifacts. Attendees leave with a repeatable benchmark approach, a readiness checklist and a practical way to turn test results into a confident go-live decision and what we learned running enterprise-scale performance benchmarks for Dynamics 365 Contact Center voice. We'll show how to turn those lessons into a repeatable benchmark you can use before go-live. Along the way we'll cover the mistakes that give teams false confidence, and the practices that help them make a go-live decision backed by evidence. You'll hear how to design a test that reflects real customer behavior, and how to ramp load safely. You'll also hear how to read the results, tell a genuine platform limit from a test-tool artifact, and show customers and stakeholders why the result can be trusted.

sessions.title: Will AI close the gender gap in the tech sector?
sessions.description: Women in tech have spent decades trying to get more women into the room. AI changes the room. If women aren't equally represented in the data, the decisions, the design, and the leadership of AI, we risk automating the very inequalities we were trying to eliminate. This discussion brings together contributors to the book, You're on Mute: 13 Lessons: 13 Lessons for Women Frustrated with the Tech Sector. Lead by author, Marie Wiese, CEO of Marketing Copilot and a 30-year veteran of the tech sector, she'll lead a discussion on how AI disruption is both an opportunity and a risk if we don’t close the AI confidence and participation gap. AI can democratize capability. But capability only becomes power when people use it. The challenge isn't: Can AI empower women? The question is: Will women be equally involved in deciding what we do with that power? Come join us, and find out.

sessions.title: Win the Moment: Real-Time AI Guidance for Every Seller, in Every Conversation
sessions.description: Deals are won or lost in the moment, like an objection, a competitor mention, or a missed discovery question. Seller Guidance in Dynamics 365 Sales puts an AI guide in that moment, with real-time cues, objection handling and competitive insights right inside the call. After the call, it evaluates the conversation, scores key selling skills and gives sellers personalized coaching insights for their next call. Join us for a live demo, understand how you can make every seller your best seller.

sessions.title: Work IQ in Copilot Studio: Unlocking the Next Generation of Enterprise Productivity Agents
sessions.description: In this session, we'll explore Work IQ in Microsoft Copilot Studio and how it helps transform organizational knowledge into actionable insights for AI agents. You'll learn how Work IQ discovers relationships between people, content, conversations, and business processes, enabling agents to provide more relevant responses and better contextual understanding. Through practical demonstrations, we'll examine how Work IQ can enhance agent experiences, improve knowledge discovery, and help organizations build more intelligent copilots that understand not only what information exists, but how it is connected across the enterprise. Whether you're a maker, developer, architect, or business leader, you'll leave with a clear understanding of how Work IQ can help create smarter AI experiences using the knowledge already available within your organization. Key Takeaways -Understand what Work IQ is and how it differs from traditional knowledge sources. -Learn how Work IQ helps agents understand organizational context. -Explore practical use cases for knowledge discovery and intelligent assistance. -See how Work IQ can improve the quality and relevance of agent responses. -Learn best practices for incorporating Work IQ into Copilot Studio solutions.

sessions.title: Your CRM Has New Coworkers: Leading Sales & Service in the Age of AI Agents
sessions.description: Dynamics 365 is evolving beyond copilots and entering a new era of AI agents—digital teammates that can research, recommend, automate, and increasingly act alongside human teams. For sales and service organizations, this shift creates a bigger challenge than technology: How do we prepare people, processes, and leadership for a workforce that now includes AI? Join Nancie Calder, MVP and Tanya Tygesen for an interactive discussion on what agentic CRM means in practice. We’ll explore the latest direction of Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service agents, the differences between copilots and autonomous agents, and the readiness strategies organizations need to move beyond experimentation into sustainable adoption. Through practical examples, governance considerations, and lessons emerging across the community, attendees will learn how to introduce AI coworkers responsibly—building trust, measuring success, and avoiding common pitfalls like poor adoption, unclear ownership, and “pilot purgatory.” Attendees will leave with a practical framework for evaluating AI readiness and preparing their organizations for the future of human + AI collaboration. Learning Objectives: 1- Understand the shift from CRM systems of record to agent-powered systems of action 2- Learn how Dynamics 365 Sales and Service agents are changing team workflows and customer experiences 3- Build an adoption and governance approach that enables trust, accountability, and business value

sessions.title: EXPO HALL- Dedicated time
New to D365 Customer Insights-Journeys... Quick, tell me what I need to know!
sessions.description: Are you new to D365 Customer Insights – Journeys? It can feel overwhelming! Real-time journeys, segments, triggers, consent, emails, and Dataverse tables can make it hard to know where to start. This session is a practical introduction for anyone who is brand new to Customer Insights – Journeys or who has inherited an environment and needs to understand how it actually works. We will focus on the essentials and avoid deep technical builds or marketing theory. You will learn how Customer Insights – Journeys fits into the Dynamics 365 ecosystem, what problems it is designed to solve, and how the core components work together. We will cover real-time journeys at a high level, core concepts like contacts, segments, triggers, journeys, and consent, and the key configuration considerations and settings to understand before building. This session is the orientation you wish you had on day one. Attendees will leave with a clear mental model of the platform and practical guidance on what to focus on next.

sessions.title: Account 360 and Contact 360: From System of Record to System of Action
sessions.description: A 360 view is not a data aggregation page. If all it does is rearrange fields the seller already has, it earns no adoption. The question customers ask is a fair one: what is this telling me that I do not already know, and what is my incentive to move off the form I have today? This session answers that with three layers, built in order. Attributes are the operational truth, the CRM facts a seller, service agent or marketer expects, in one place and editable where they live. Insights are the calculated and derived signals that turn records into what is happening and what deserves attention, prioritized rather than dumped. Reasoning is grounded AI over CRM plus permissioned Microsoft 365, service and marketing context that answers the open question the fields cannot, and produces a next action. We will show Account 360 and Contact 360 against three seller moments, qualification, meeting preparation, and account and relationship expansion, and cover the design principles that make the experience adoptable: lead with the operational job, keep the fundamentals always available and never gated behind an AI panel, and respect the customization every customer already runs rather than replacing it. We will also show how sellers pin the attributes that matter to their own book of business and how the system learns from those choices over time. What attendees will learn: The attribute, insight and reasoning model, and why the build order matters How Account 360 and Contact 360 differ and when each is the right lens How to extend the 360 without abandoning the customization you already run How one shared customer truth serves sales, service and marketing differently Governance, permissions and provenance across the 360 experience

sessions.title: Beyond the Prompt: Extending Dynamics 365 Agents with Dataverse MCP
sessions.description: Building an agent demo is easy. Extending it to work with real Dynamics 365 data and business requirements is where the work begins. In this demo-driven session, Janise Dismuke shares practical techniques for extending Copilot Studio agents using the Microsoft Dataverse Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Attendees will see how an agent can discover Dataverse tables, understand table structures, and answer natural-language questions using business data. The session will cover configuring Dataverse MCP, selecting and managing the tools exposed to an agent, handling connections and permissions, and troubleshooting common environment and configuration problems. Janise will also share guidance for deciding when Dataverse MCP is the right extension pattern and when agent flows, connectors, or custom APIs are a better choice. Attendees will leave with a practical playbook for creating Dynamics 365 agents that move beyond scripted answers and interact intelligently with enterprise data. Learning objectives Configure the Dataverse MCP server as a Copilot Studio tool. Enable agents to discover and interact with Dynamics 365 data. Manage the tools, connections, permissions, and environments involved. Choose between Dataverse MCP, agent flows, connectors, and custom APIs. Troubleshoot common agent-extension issues.

sessions.title: Business Central Meets AI: 10 Practical Use Cases
sessions.description: In this session we will walk through 10 practical AI use cases that Business Central users can benefit from in their daily workflow. Using real use cases we'll explore how organizations are using AI alongside Business Central to reduce manual tasks, improve accuracy, and shift employees from repetitive tasks to high value work. We'll cover examples across finance, operations, sales, and customer service, including expense processing, invoice automation, cash application, customer onboarding, order entry, forecasting, and credit reviews. Don't worry, we'll also cover where AI can help, and where humans still need to be included. You will leave with practical ideas and a framework on how AI and Business Central can work together in the Microsoft Ecosystem.

sessions.title: Configure 3P CCaaS integration
sessions.description: Configure 3P CCaaS integration with NiCE and Five9

sessions.title: Crossing the AI Pilot-to-Production Chasm in the Contact Center
sessions.description: Many teams have promising AI pilots, but fewer have scaled them into trusted production systems. This guided discussion will bring customers and partners together to discuss what blocks AI programs from scaling, including data readiness, governance, integration, measurement, human handoff, and organizational change. Participants will share lessons learned and leave with practical ideas for moving from experimentation to enterprise adoption.

sessions.title: From Confusion to Confidence: Best Practices for Dynamics 365 F&O License Validation
sessions.description: Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) licensing can be complex, making it critical for organizations to understand the license validation process and maintain an optimized licensing strategy. This session provides a practical overview of Dynamics 365 F&O license validation, helping customers and Microsoft teams understand what is evaluated, why validation matters, and how to prepare effectively. Attendees will learn how security roles, user activity, and assigned licenses are assessed to determine licensing requirements, along with common licensing challenges and areas organizations should regularly review. We will discuss proven strategies for improving license alignment, maintaining an efficient licensing posture, and navigating validation with confidence. The session will also explore how AI agents can streamline onboarding and offboarding processes, improve operational efficiency, and support ongoing license management efforts with a live demonstration of tools available to customers. Attendees will also get an early look at upcoming enhancements to the validation experience and learn what organizations should consider now to stay ahead of future licensing and governance changes. Whether you are responsible for licensing, administration, implementation, or customer success, this session will provide actionable insights to help optimize your Dynamics 365 environment, reduce surprises, and prepare for future validation activities.

sessions.title: Implementing AI-Powered Contact Centers: Architecture and Implementation Lessons
sessions.description: Building an AI-first contact center requires more than connecting channels and enabling new capabilities. Production deployments must integrate channels, routing, identity, knowledge, telephony, analytics, and AI while meeting demanding security and operational requirements. Join Dynamics 365 FastTrack for a deep dive on the key architecture decisions for Dynamics 365 Contact Center, including coexistence with existing platforms, migration sequencing, capacity and performance, data boundaries, agent experience, and operational readiness. The session will highlight recurring implementation risks and show how to structure design reviews, testing, and rollout waves for a resilient AI-first contact center.

sessions.title: Is Business Central the right ERP for your future?
sessions.description: Validate the fit, business value, and capabilities before making your ERP investment (AI focused).

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Agentic financial close - streamline account reconciliation and agentic close
sessions.description: See how agentic reconciliation and close compress the close calendar and surface exceptions before they become fire drills. Get an early look at the Control Command Center.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Agentic order to cash
sessions.description: Watch agents drive order, fulfillment, invoicing, and collections with fewer handoffs and faster cash. See where automation pays off first in your O2C cycle.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: AI-Powered Store Experiences with Dynamics 365 Commerce
sessions.description: See how AI reshapes the in-store experience for shoppers and associates alike. Real scenarios across assisted selling, inventory visibility, and store operations.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Day in the life of a CFO
sessions.description: Spend a day in the CFO's seat — signals, decisions, and escalations — with agents doing the legwork behind each one. A narrative demo of how the finance leader's day changes.

sessions.title: Plan for the Worst, to Calm the "What If's"
sessions.description: Go-live is scary for everyone! All the "What if's" can be a huge distraction. But what if you actually proactively planned for the worst? Janae and Tracy will walk you through creating contingency plans for go-live and critical business flows to support critical operations if D365 availability is disrupted. They'll showcase the effort done with a recent client Dynamics F&O implementation.

sessions.title: The Client Story: What Nearly Went Wrong - And Why It Didn't
sessions.description: From USA to APAC, hear from a Microsoft client and a non-atypical Microsoft partner in their quest to deliver a successful Power Apps implementation in the midst of a global D365 cross-product multi-million pound programme. Through the perspectives of both the implementation partner and the independent assurance team, we'll explore the decisions, challenges and warning signs that threatened programme success, and the practical interventions that kept delivery on track. Rather than focusing on failure, this is an honest discussion about collaboration, constructive challenge and shared accountability. Attendees will leave with practical lessons they can apply to strengthen governance, reduce delivery risk and build greater confidence into their own transformation programmes.

sessions.title: Two People, One AI Team: Closing the ECN Gap with Multi-Agent AI
sessions.description: Alligator Holdings, LLC ran an ECN modernization project with a two-person internal team directing multiple AI agents working in concert; no bolt-on platform, all native X++. AI agents analyzed our D365 F&O Engineering Change Management and CAPA capabilities and ran the fit-gap analysis, surfacing the real gaps: a controlled-document register, a CAPA-to-ECO cross-reference, acknowledgment logging, and reporting. AI agents then vibe-coded the X++ extension that closes those gaps directly inside D365, while other agents managed the project; sequencing work, tracking status, and flagging blockers. Agents also serve as an additional front end via the MCP server, giving users a conversational layer on top of native ECM screens. The agent can be used to compare engineering drawing revisions to auto-fill ECN base data, cutting manual entry at intake. This session covers how a small internal team paired with a multi-agent AI workflow to handle analysis, project management, X++ development, and agent design; what worked, what needed correction, and what we'd do differently. Attendees leave with a practical blueprint for a lean team orchestrating multiple AI agents across roles on a native D365 extension.

sessions.title: Under the Hood: Dataverse, Copilot and Work IQ
sessions.description: Where does the intelligence behind Copilot or Work IQ actually come from? This session goes under the hood of the Dataverse-powered intelligence that makes business data agent-ready. Walk through how Dataverse grounds agents in business data and meaning: the semantic models and search that deliver targeted, curated answers beyond raw tables and metadata; reusable business skills that capture how your organization works; and how agentic search and actions let agents reason over and act on that intelligence. See how these layers combine to deliver the Dataverse-powered intelligence Work IQ brings to every agent, and how to design for it at enterprise scale.

sessions.title: HAPPY HOUR
Keynote
EXPO HALL
Accelerating AI Adoption with Dynamics 365 Agent Templates
sessions.description: AI agents are already changing how finance, supply chain, and commerce teams work, and you don't have to start from a blank canvas. Join Dynamics 365 FastTrack for a practical tour of the agentic options for Dynamics 365 ERP. We'll cover the first-party agents built into the apps, agent templates you can adapt to your own business scenarios, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets agents securely use ERP data and business logic. Hear first-hand from customers about how they are using agents today and what results they're seeing. We'll explain how to pick the right approach for each scenario, what to reuse, customize, and validate, and how to get agents ready for your users.

sessions.title: AI Everywhere: Build CCAI Agents for Dynamics 365 and Third-Party Contact Centers
sessions.description: Customers do not always start from a blank slate. Many already have existing contact center platforms, telephony investments, and service workflows they need to modernize without disrupting operations. In this session, learn how the new CCAI builder experience helps teams design, test, and deploy intelligent agents across Dynamics 365 Contact Center and third-party CCaaS environments. We will show how organizations can adopt AI incrementally, extend existing investments, and build toward a unified Microsoft-led customer service architecture.

sessions.title: From Email to Resolution: Building Agentic Customer Service with AI
sessions.description: Transforming customer service with AI starts with automating the case lifecycle, from the initial customer inquiry through case creation, classification, resolution, and closure. In this hands-on lab, you'll learn how to configure and use Microsoft's first-party Customer Service agents in Dynamics 365 Customer Service to streamline email-based support scenarios. Using a real-world business scenario, you'll explore how the Case Management Agent (CMA) and Customer Intent Agent (CIA) work together to automate case creation, identify customer intent, enrich case information, and support resolution workflows. You'll gain practical experience configuring email-to-case automation, enabling AI-driven case classification and field updates, defining customer intents, and associating knowledge and resolution guidance with specific customer requests. Through guided exercises, attendees will see how AI agents can reduce manual effort, improve case accuracy, and accelerate resolution while maintaining appropriate human oversight. The lab will walk through an end-to-end customer service scenario, from receiving an incoming customer email to automatically creating and enriching a case, identifying the customer's intent, generating follow-up communications, and completing the case resolution and closure process. By the end of the session, you'll have hands-on experience configuring and validating an agentic customer service workflow that can be adapted to real-world customer implementations.

sessions.title: From First Touch to Resolution: Real-World Stories of Agentic Customer Engagement
sessions.description: What happens when AI agents become part of the customer journey—not just a demo or experiment? Join fellow Dynamics 365 customers for a candid roundtable on how organizations are bringing agents into real-world sales, service, and customer engagement scenarios. We’ll explore where agents are delivering value today, how organizations are deciding where humans stay in the loop, what customers and employees need in order to trust agentic experiences, and what teams are learning as they move from experimentation toward production. Bring your own experience to the conversation. What scenarios have you tried? Where have agents made a difference? What hasn’t worked as expected? And what would you do differently the next time?

sessions.title: From One Food Bank to Many: Feeding America's Dynamics 365 Rollout Hosted by Sunrise Technologies
sessions.description: Feeding America knows where its food is coming from. What it's building now is a fast, reliable way to see where it needs to go: which donations are time-sensitive, which food banks have capacity to take them, and how to move inventory before it spoils. This session covers Feeding America's current project to build that visibility using Dynamics 365, including tracking donated inventory from intake through delivery, and giving staff the data to accept food that would otherwise be thrown away. The initial Dynamics 365 demos showed enough promise to become the starting point for something bigger: a pilot program now underway to roll the same system out to food banks across the country, so affiliates nationwide can eventually see inventory and capacity the same way, and respond to donations on the same timeline. Attendees will hear directly what it's taking to implement a national rollout of Dynamics 365, including what's staying consistent at every site, what's had to flex, and what Feeding America is learning in real time as more food banks come online.

sessions.title: From the Shop Floor to the Boardroom: Building an AI Strategy That Actually Works in Manufacturing
sessions.description: Everyone is talking about AI. Very few manufacturing organizations know where to begin. After leading a Dynamics 365 implementation across a complex manufacturing environment, we quickly discovered that AI wasn't about replacing people—it was about eliminating friction. The biggest challenge wasn't choosing the right model. It was identifying the operational problems worth solving. This session walks through a practical framework for introducing AI inside a manufacturing organization. You'll learn how we identified high-value opportunities, prioritized projects, built business trust, and focused on measurable operational improvements rather than flashy demonstrations. We'll discuss real examples across production, inventory, quality, analytics, and knowledge management while sharing lessons learned, common pitfalls, and how to prepare your Dynamics 365 environment for AI success. Attendees will leave with a roadmap they can immediately apply inside their own organization, regardless of where they are on their AI journey. Takeaways How to identify AI projects with measurable ROI Preparing D365 for AI readiness Building trust with operations and leadership Common mistakes organizations make Creating an AI roadmap instead of isolated experiments

sessions.title: Get more from your Business Central investment
sessions.description: Optimize operations, boost productivity, troubleshoot faster, and unlock more value with AI.

sessions.title: Is Your Organization Ready for D365? A Self-Assessment for Leaders
sessions.description: Your D365 project may have a budget, a timeline, and an implementation partner. But do your people have the time, knowledge, and support to make it successful? At this demo station, we’ll walk through a practical self-assessment using a realistic company preparing for D365. Together, we’ll examine five dimensions: change capacity, stakeholder alignment, adoption ownership, readiness, and post-go-live sustainability. Follow the company’s assessment as we uncover gaps that are easy to overlook: employees expected to support implementation alongside their daily responsibilities, training completion that doesn’t necessarily mean people can perform their work, and a go-live plan without clear ownership for continued adoption. We’ll demonstrate how to interpret the findings, decide what needs attention, and identify manageable next steps. Drawing on hands-on experience helping organizations learn and adopt D365, we’ll show how small, purposeful actions across these areas can strengthen the implementation foundation. You’ll also have an opportunity to consider how the same questions apply to your organization. Whether you’re evaluating D365 or already implementing, leave with a self-assessment framework you can use with your team and practical questions to guide conversations with internal stakeholders and implementation partners.

sessions.title: Living Account Plans: AI Native Account, Territory and Portfolio Planning in Dynamics 365 Sales
sessions.description: Account planning means very different things depending on who you ask. A territory manager, a strategic account owner and a portfolio seller all plan, but they plan at different scopes and care about different signals. Most organizations solve this with slideware that is accurate the day it is built and stale a month later. This session shows a single planning model in Dynamics 365 Sales that supports all three archetypes without separate solutions or workarounds, with plans drafted and kept current by Sales Research Agent while the seller keeps control of every judgment. We will walk three planning scenarios end to end. A portfolio seller who looks behind on attainment until the quarterly split shows two named accounts went quiet. A strategic account that is financially on track while its economic buyer is weeks from leaving. A territory where one deal, one seller's coverage gap and one unattacked vertical explain the entire forecast risk. In each case the point is the same: the plan surfaces the narrative, not a generic risk score. We will also cover the operating model that keeps plans alive, including whitespace and buying group coverage, renewal risk flags, review cadence, and the nudges that stop a plan decaying between quarters. What attendees will learn: One data model that supports account, territory and portfolio planning How AI drafts a plan and exactly where the human stays in the loop How to surface whitespace, stakeholder risk and coverage gaps as named, actionable signals How to run plan reviews so leadership can see status without asking for it How planning shows up across Dynamics 365, Copilot and the seller's flow of work

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Complex Service with Field Service
sessions.description: See how Field Service handles jobs that span a work order — long-running work, multiple crews, and complex assets. Practical patterns for organizations beyond simple break-fix and preventative maintenance.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Customer Choice to Profitable Fulfillment: Omnichannel Price, Promise, & Fulfill
sessions.description: This session follows one customer order from the moment a customer or sales associate chooses a delivery option through pricing, delivery-date commitment, inventory protection, fulfillment-node selection, and warehouse execution. Rather than demonstrating Unified Pricing Management, Order Promising, Inventory Visibility, and Distributed Order Management as separate capabilities, the session presents them as one connected omnichannel business flow. The story shows how Dynamics 365 can help make the right commercial and fulfillment decisions at each stage: offer the right delivery choice, calculate the right price, provide a reliable, expected delivery date, protect the inventory behind that promise, and determine the most appropriate location from which to fulfill the order.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: How to optimize your system for the best performance and automation in Finance
sessions.description: The engineering-backed guide to making Finance run fast at scale — batch, integrations, data, and automation design. Leave with a concrete tuning checklist.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Manage cost and security for your AI deployments
sessions.description: See how AI reshapes the in-store experience for shoppers and associates alike. Real scenarios across assisted selling, inventory visibility, and store operations.

sessions.title: PREMIERING: Skills Are the New Superpower: Building Smarter Copilot Studio Agents
sessions.description: In 2026, the key to building powerful agents lies in the ability to understand and create "Skills." It started with OpenClaw and Claude Cowork, made its way to Copilot Cowork, and has now arrived in the new generation of agents in Copilot Studio. If your agents still feel more like scripted chatbots with pages of instructions than intelligent assistants, skills are the missing ingredient. In this session, I will break down exactly what skills are, why they matter, and how they fit into the broader architecture of an effective agent. You'll learn the difference between a skill and an Instruction or Knowledge source, when to build a skill versus simply relying on generative orchestration, and how well-designed skills make your agents more reliable, reusable, and maintainable over time, even with complex scenarios. We'll walk through the practical mechanics of building a skill from scratch: defining clear inputs, outputs and scope, embedding powerful code-driven scripts for heavy-lifting tasks, and testing it so it performs predictably in production. Along the way, we'll cover common pitfalls that lead to bloated, fragile agents, and how disciplined skill-building habits prevent them. Whether you're building your first agent or leveling up ones already in production, you'll leave with a clear mental model for skills and the hands-on knowledge to start building your own. Soon, your Copilot Studio agents will go from reactive responders into genuinely useful digital teammates.

sessions.title: Rewiring the Enterprise: AI, Agents and Business Transformation with Dynamics 365 Hosted by PwC
sessions.description: As organizations modernize core business processes and technology, AI, automation and agentic capabilities are redefining how transformation is implemented. In this executive panel, leaders from PwC and our client organizations will share practical perspectives on simplifying complex environments, connecting processes across the enterprise, and using Dynamics 365 and Copilot to enable more intelligent, agent-driven ways of working. The conversation will focus on how executives can move beyond incremental AI use cases to rethink how work is performed, optimize the collaboration between people and agents, and drive measurable value across customer experience, operations, finance and service, while preserving the capabilities that drive today's success

sessions.title: Roundtable: Service in D365 and Microsoft Copilot
sessions.description: Discover how AI is transforming customer service across Microsoft Copilot and Dynamics 365. Explore how service teams can use Copilot Home to understand customer context, find answers, and resolve cases faster; Cowork to delegate complex, multi-step tasks; Code to build tailored service experiences; and Autopilot to proactively monitor and automate recurring work. We'll also showcase purpose-built agents in Dynamics 365, including Intent Assist, that help service representatives understand customer needs and take the right next action. See how these capabilities come together to improve productivity, reduce manual effort, and deliver faster, more personalized customer experiences.

sessions.title: See It Live: AI-Powered Contact Center Experiences for Agents & Supervisors
sessions.description: Step into the future of customer engagement with Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This session provides a comprehensive overview of Microsoft’s AI-powered contact center solution, highlighting key differences between Dynamics 365 Customer Service Premium and Contact Center solutions. Through live demos, you’ll experience agent and supervisor interfaces, inbound and outbound voice calls, live chat, SMS, and email handling—all powered by AI. We’ll also explore productivity-enhancing features like real-time insights, intelligent routing, and Copilot assistance that help teams deliver exceptional service. Walk away with a clear understanding of how Dynamics 365 Contact Center can modernize your operations and elevate customer experiences.

sessions.title: Simplify Approvals Across Your Business Hosted by Stoneridge Software
sessions.description: Approvals are everywhere, from time off and expenses to invoices, purchase requests, and credit increases. See how Stoneridge’s centralized approvals app and agent brings requests into one place, delivers them through Outlook, Teams, or an app, and gives approvers the context they need to make decisions quickly.

sessions.title: The Intelligent Agent Desktop: Extending Copilot and Productivity Tools in D365 Customer Service
sessions.description: Customer service leaders need agents focused on resolving issues—not switching apps, hunting for information, or repeating manual steps. Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Contact Center offer a powerful multisession workspace with Productivity Tools and AI capabilities that can reduce effort, improve consistency, and accelerate outcomes. In this session, you'll learn how to customize and extend Productivity Tools—macros, agent scripts, smart assist, and custom experiences—to create an intelligent, AI-enabled agent desktop. We’ll explore practical patterns for integrating Microsoft Copilot, AI recommendations, Copilot Studio agents, contextual guidance, and embedded Power Apps components directly into the workspace. Attendees will leave with design patterns, governance considerations, and implementation strategies for transforming disconnected screens into a unified service experience where agents and AI work together to speed resolution, reduce training time, and improve customer satisfaction at scale.

sessions.title: CUSTOMER ROUND TABLE
LUNCH
Amplifying Human Leadership with Copilot Studio
sessions.description: Every people manager knows the challenge: valuable hours are spent digging through emails, Teams messages, meeting notes, utilization reports, and spreadsheets just to prepare for a meaningful one-on-one conversation. The result is less time for coaching, mentorship, and human connection. In this session, Cheik Kone shares how he designed and implemented a real-world Microsoft Copilot Studio agent that automatically prepares managers for employee 1:1 meetings by aggregating insights from Outlook, Microsoft Teams, OneNote, Dynamics 365, and resource planning data. Rather than replacing managers, the solution amplifies their ability to lead with empathy, context, and confidence. Attendees will learn how the agent generates prioritized employee briefings, identifies risks and opportunities, produces weekly team health summaries, and preserves organizational knowledge all using native Microsoft 365 and Copilot Studio capabilities. Through architecture diagrams, implementation guidance, and lessons learned, this session demonstrates how organizations can leverage agentic AI to enhance leadership effectiveness while keeping humans firmly at the center of decision-making. Whether you're a business leader, architect, consultant, or AI enthusiast, you'll leave with practical ideas for building human-centered AI agents that drive measurable business value and stronger employee engagement.

sessions.title: Business Central: Concierge services for a seamless implementation
sessions.description: Planning a new ERP implementation or migration can be complex, but you don't have to navigate it alone. Join this session to learn how Microsoft’s Concierge service for Dynamics 365 Business Central helps customers and partners accelerate implementations, reduce risk, and achieve faster time to value. We'll walk through the end-to-end Concierge experience, including implementation planning and service, readiness review and go-live support. Discover the best practices and learnings to evaluate how Concierge services might help you to a successful go-live faster. Whether you're evaluating Business Central, preparing for migration, or already underway with an implementation, learn how the Concierge service can help you and learn from our best practice. The service is available for engagements ranging from three to twelve months, providing the right level of support at every stage of your Business Central journey.

sessions.title: Copilot Cowork - Getting Started
sessions.description: This tool is AWESOME! Take AI from talking about work to doing work. In this session, we are going to show you what Cowork is, how to get going with it, show how you can build reusable skills, and even explain the credits. A lot to cover but I want to make sure you walk out of the session craving going back to your hotel room and putting it to work for you. And yeah, not technically part of the Power Platform but a good complement and a key part of the ecosystem. You don't want to build a full custom agent to do something Cowork can do with a prompt, do you? 🤔

sessions.title: From Vision to Value: Accelerating Dynamics 365 Contact Center with Activate
sessions.description: Delivering a modern, AI-powered contact center requires more than innovative technology—it demands a smarter, more accelerated approach to implementation. As organizations look to embrace AI and agentic capabilities, the ability to simplify complexity, accelerate deployment, and realize business value has become a critical differentiator. Discover how Dynamics 365 Activate is advancing the implementation journey through AI-driven experiences and intelligent implementation approaches, helping organizations rethink how they plan, execute, and accelerate their Dynamics 365 transformation. Explore how these emerging capabilities, combined with Dynamics 365 Contact Center and proven implementation practices, can help teams navigate implementation challenges, improve readiness, and establish a stronger foundation for AI-powered contact center experiences. Join us to explore the evolving role of AI in implementation, understand how Activate fits into the broader Dynamics 365 Contact Center journey, and discover practical approaches to moving from implementation complexity to measurable business impact.

sessions.title: Get It Right the First Time: A Finance Leader's Story of a Secure, AI-Ready D365 Transformation
sessions.description: Every ERP transformation promises efficiency. Few deliver it without painful rework, security gaps discovered too late, or an AI strategy bolted on after go-live. This session tells the story of a finance leader who did it differently — and got it right the first time. In a candid, unscripted conversation, a senior leader from [Customer] sits down with Mike Gillis of RSM to walk through their journey to Dynamics 365: why they made the move, the decisions that mattered most, and the moments that could have derailed it. This isn't a product demo. It's an honest look at what a thoughtful transformation actually requires. Together they'll unpack how the organization treated security, governance, and change management as day-one design decisions rather than afterthoughts — and why that discipline paid off as AI and Copilot entered the picture. Attendees will hear how the customer approached AI governance and Security Copilot to protect their environment, how they built adoption momentum before go-live rather than chasing it afterward, and how they're now positioned to get more value out of their Microsoft and RSM investment over time. If you're moving off Dynamics GP, evaluating a jump to D365, or planning a transformation you can't afford to redo, this conversation is your playbook for doing it deliberately — and doing it once.

sessions.title: Making Sales Agent Speak Your Business Language
sessions.description: The quality of Sales Agent responses depends on how well it understands your business. In this session, you'll learn how to configure the capabilities that have the greatest impact on answer quality, including semantic models, glossaries, business skills, CRM summaries, and evaluation frameworks. Together, these capabilities help Sales Agent understand your organization's terminology, acronyms, business processes, and sales methodology without requiring changes to your underlying CRM schema. We will demonstrate how semantic models provide business context from CRM data, how glossaries help map business language to CRM entities, and how business skills capture reusable business logic, workflows, and organizational processes that can be shared across Sales Agent experiences. Attendees will see practical examples of teaching Sales Agent company-specific vocabulary, sales motions, and operational guidance to deliver more relevant and consistent responses. You'll also learn how to build a repeatable evaluation strategy using hero prompts and real business scenarios to validate quality before rollout and after every configuration change. What attendees will learn How glossaries and business skills improve answer quality and business alignment How Sales Agent interprets CRM metadata, semantic models, and business context How to teach Sales Agent your organization's terminology, acronyms, and sales processes How to build effective hero prompts, prompt libraries, and test suites

sessions.title: Meet Your New AI Team: D365 Customer Service & Contact Center Agents
sessions.description: What if your customer service team had AI teammates that never slept, never forgot a process, and were always ready to help? In this session, we'll take a hands-on look at the AI agents transforming Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Contact Center. You'll see the Knowledge Management Agent keep knowledge articles accurate and up to date, the Case Management Agent help resolve customer issues faster, the Intent Agent uncover why customers are reaching out, and the Quality Evaluation Agent automatically reviewing support for quality and compliance. This isn't a slide deck full of AI buzzwords. It's a live demonstration of what these agents actually do, how they work together, and where they can save your organization time while improving both customer and agent experiences. Whether you're evaluating AI or ready to put it to work, you'll leave with a clear understanding of what's possible today.
