sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Agentic ERP for Service Centric Enterprises
sessions.description: See how agents run the service business end to end — quote, resource, deliver, bill, recognize — across Finance, Project Operations, Human Resources and Field Service. Leave with a clear picture of where agentic ERP removes handoffs in your service delivery chain.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Getting started with financial planning - get out of excel and into planning
sessions.description: A practical on-ramp for teams moving budgeting and forecasting out of Excel and into Dynamics 365 financial planning. Includes the setup sequence, common pitfalls, and a first-cycle checklist.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Hire to Retire, Rewired for Frontier Workforce with D365 HR and AI Agents
sessions.description: See how Dynamics 365 HR and AI agents reshape the employee lifecycle for a workforce where people and agents work side by side. Real scenarios from hiring through offboarding.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Insight to action with Business performance analytics and Analytics MCP
sessions.description: See how Business Performance Analytics and Analytics MCP turn ERP data into answers — and answers into action inside the business process. Live demos across finance and operations questions.

sessions.title: Quality Without Blind Spots: Managing Human and AI Agents at Scale
sessions.description: As autonomous agents become part of the service workforce, quality management must evolve beyond traditional human-agent scorecards. This session explores how service leaders can evaluate both human and AI interactions through a unified quality framework. Learn how conversation analytics, compliance checks, AI behavior monitoring, and coaching insights help teams manage service quality at scale. Attendees will leave with a practical model for measuring performance across a blended human and autonomous workforce.

sessions.title: Supervising a team of Sales agents as part of the sales team
sessions.description: As AI agents become integral members of the sales organization, effective supervision and governance are critical to driving business value at scale. In this session, explore how multiple sales agents are managed across lead qualification, research, engagement, and opportunity management. Learn best practices for agent orchestration, human oversight, performance monitoring, security, and governance frameworks. Discover how sales leaders can confidently manage a hybrid workforce of sellers and AI agents to increase productivity, consistency, and customer impact.

sessions.title: Unified Field to Finance Journey with D365 Project Operations, Field Service and F&O
sessions.description: In many organizations, project planning, field execution, and financial reporting still live in separate systems, leading to disconnected data, manual handoffs, and limited visibility from the field to finance. With the modern Dynamics 365 architecture, this no longer has to be the case. In this session, attendees will learn how Dynamics 365 Project Operations, Field Service, and Finance & Operations work together to deliver a truly end‑to‑end project delivery experience. We will walk through real‑world scenarios that show how projects are planned, executed in the field, captured accurately through time, materials, and costs, and seamlessly reflected downstream in finance, without duplicating effort or losing visibility. Whether you are managing project‑based work with field execution, break/fix services tied to projects, or complex asset‑centric operations, this session will demonstrate how a single pane of glass can help teams improve operational efficiency, increase financial accuracy, and make better, faster decisions across the entire project lifecycle. This session is ideal for project managers, field service leaders, functional consultants, and solution architects looking to understand how to design and leverage an integrated Dynamics 365 solution in real-world implementation

sessions.title: Vibe coding: build fast, break faster
sessions.description: Vibe coding turned everyone into a builder. Describe an app in plain language, get working software back in minutes. The demos are everywhere, and they all stop at the same place: it works. That is exactly where the interesting part begins. This session builds a real app live, from a single sentence, in front of the room. Then it does what no demo does. It turns on the app and breaks it, live, on purpose. Watch data leak where it shouldn't. Watch the app take an action no one authorized. Watch a prototype pretend to be production and almost get away with it. Each break comes paired with the fix, the control that turns a fragile toy into something an organization can actually run. The live build runs on vibe.powerapps, but the method sits above any single tool. The same pressure test applies whether you build in Power Apps, Lovable, Base44, or whatever you reach for next. Pick your vibe coding app of choice and take the framework with you. The example is an HR app, because people data raises the stakes fast. The method works for anything. By the end, the build is not the lesson. The pressure test is. Attendees leave able to look at any vibe-coded app, their own or someone else's, and know where it will fail and how to hold it together. Speed is easy now. Control is the skill. This session is about having both.

sessions.title: BREAK
AI-First Transformation: Inspiring Change Across the Organization
sessions.description: Becoming an AI-first organization requires more than implementing new technology—it requires aligning people, processes, data, and leadership. This session explores how organizations are moving beyond AI experimentation to achieve enterprise-wide adoption and measurable business outcomes. Attendees will learn practical strategies for driving user adoption, preparing an AI-ready technology and data foundation, identifying high-value use cases, and establishing governance that supports innovation while managing risk. Through real-world examples and lessons learned, discover how business and technology leaders can create a culture where AI becomes part of everyday work and a catalyst for lasting transformation. Participants will learn how to: People: Build leadership alignment and prepare employees for AI-driven change. Process: Identify, prioritize, and scale AI use cases that deliver measurable value. Technology: Understand the key data, governance, and technology requirements for AI readiness. Organization-wide: Create a framework for sustainable AI adoption and continuous innovation.

sessions.title: Community Is the New Revenue Funnel
sessions.description: In 2026, people using D365, don’t just want solutions - they want belonging. Traditional patterns at events were built for transactions, not trust. But the people gaining insight and benefit today are doing something radically different: turning their communities into their most powerful growth engine. Join Community leaders Sam Bush and Kate Coffey-Bacon for a candid conversation on why community is the new revenue currency- and how connection, collaboration, and authenticity are rewriting the overall playbook. Learn how to build out your perfectly formed group of advocates and amplifiers, how earnest interaction and conversation turns into reward, and why real relationships are the key into long-term revenue (defined in whatever you are looking to gain). You’ll walk away with a strong understanding of why investing in community is beneficial for you and your organization in so many ways!

sessions.description: Join Dynamics 365 FastTrack and Fifth Third Bank to explore their experience using Dynamics 365 Activate to support a streamlined automated migration to Dynamics 365. sessions.title: From Startup to Scale: Building a Foundation for Growth with Dynamics 365 Hosted by Avanade
sessions.description: How do you build enterprise-ready processes while your business is growing just as quickly? sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Agentic ERP for Product Centric Enterprises
sessions.description: Follow a product from supply signal to shelf as agents coordinate planning, warehouse, and commerce in a single flow. See what product-centric enterprises can automate today and what's landing next.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Agentic ERP Platform, Turbo-charge transformation with Agents, Cowork and more
sessions.description: Discover how the Agentic ERP platform accelerates AI transformation by combining autonomous agents, delegated work through Copilot Cowork, and interactive chat. See how these experiences work together to streamline complex processes, improve productivity, and reshape how people engage with enterprise operations.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: AI Powered procure to pay and Supplier Engagement
sessions.description: See how AI makes procurement more impactful by streamlining requisitions, purchase orders, receipts, matching, and payments while strengthening supplier engagement. Learn how agents and procurement teams collaborate with vendors to resolve exceptions faster, improve transparency, and drive a more connected, touchless procure-to-pay process.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Grow your business, not your database
sessions.description: Learn how leading customers keep ERP fast and affordable as data volumes climb — archiving, lifecycle, and data platform choices. Includes the levers that matter most and the ones that don't.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Modern Manufacturing with Dynamics 365
sessions.description: See how Dynamics 365 helps manufacturers improve operational efficiency, product quality, compliance, and traceability across the production lifecycle. Explore how production execution, quality management, non-conformance handling, and end-to-end traceability work together to reduce risk, increase agility, and drive continuous improvement. Follow real-world manufacturing scenarios that demonstrate how connected data, automation, and AI-powered insights help manufacturers respond faster, improve outcomes, and deliver high-quality products at scale.

sessions.title: Microsoft Roundtable: Executive Dialogue on Agentic ERP with CPO Sameer Verma
sessions.description: Join Dynamics 365 ERP Chief Product Officer Sameer Verma for an executive roundtable on leading in the era of the agentic enterprise. This strategic conversation will bring together business and technology leaders to exchange perspectives on how AI and agents are reshaping ERP, decision-making, and the way work gets done. Sameer will share Microsoft’s perspective on the evolution toward Agentic ERP, inviting participants to discuss their priorities and challenges, share what they are learning, and explore what it will take to drive business outcomes with agentic AI.

sessions.title: Preparing Business Central for the AI Era: The Architectural Decisions You Need to Make Today
sessions.description: AI capabilities are rapidly becoming part of the Microsoft business application ecosystem, but successful adoption depends on more than enabling Copilot features. Organizations need clean data, well-defined processes, secure integrations, and scalable architecture. This session explores how Business Central architects can prepare their environments today to take advantage of emerging AI capabilities tomorrow. Attendees will learn practical approaches to data governance, integration design, security, and process optimization that create a foundation for future AI initiatives.

sessions.title: Right-Size & Secure Your Data Estate: Governing & Managing Dataverse and Dynamics 365
sessions.description: As your data estate grows, governing and managing it well is what keeps it fast, compliant, and cost-effective. This session walks through the latest improvements to govern and manage your data across Dynamics 365 and Dataverse - and ultimately right-size it. See how to gain visibility into storage and capacity, apply data lifecycle policies (retention, archival, and recovery with the recycle bin), and manage capacity and cost so you pay for what you actually need. Learn how to design data security models that balance performance, compliance, and sustainability, and how new tooling helps you find, prioritize, and act - shifting from reactive cleanup to proactive, policy-driven data security & data management. Walk away with a clear approach to a well-governed, right-sized data foundation powered by Dataverse.

sessions.title: Sales Research Agent: Turning Sales Questions into Verifiable Answers and Actions
sessions.description: Sales leaders make revenue decisions every day on partial evidence. Pipeline reviews run on stale spreadsheets, forecast calls turn into arguments about whose numbers are right, and the analysis that would settle it takes a data team a week to produce. Sales Research Agent brings deep, verifiable business research directly into Dynamics 365 Sales. It supports a working dialogue with enterprise data, so a sales leader can ask a real question, see the reasoning and the sources behind the answer, and move straight to a recommended action rather than a slide request. This session walks through the research topics teams use most: forecasting and scenario modeling, pipeline health and coverage, deal hygiene and risk, seller productivity and coaching, territory and regional strategy, industry and segment focus, win and loss analysis, and sales cycle and funnel analysis. We will show how organizations progress from ad hoc natural language questions to standardized insight loops that run on a cadence, and how to keep every answer grounded in your own data and business context. What attendees will learn: - How Sales Research Agent grounds answers in CRM data with visible reasoning and sources - Which research topics deliver value fastest, and the order to introduce them - How to move from ad hoc questions to standardized, repeatable insight loops - How to shape output into the artifact your business runs on, from a short summary to a full analysis - How to evaluate answer quality before you put the agent in front of sales leadership

sessions.title: The AI-First Contact Center: Roadmap and Vision
sessions.description: Customer service is entering a new era where AI is not an add-on, but the foundation for how work gets done. This session lays out Microsoft's vision for the AI-first contact center, including autonomous agents, human assist, supervisor intelligence, unified context, and enterprise-grade governance. Attendees will understand where Dynamics 365 Contact Center is headed and how to prepare their organizations for the next generation of customer engagement.

sessions.title: The Fabric of Success: One Manufacturer’s Journey to Microsoft Fabric and AI Readiness
sessions.description: Building a modern data platform is not a single technology decision - it is an ongoing journey shaped by architecture, governance, business priorities, and organizational maturity. This session follows one manufacturer’s evolution toward Microsoft Fabric, including the decisions, challenges, and partnerships that influenced the final solution. Attendees will gain an honest, practical perspective on what it takes to create a scalable analytics foundation that is ready for future AI initiatives. - Trace the evolution of the analytics platform from Synapse Link to Microsoft Fabric - Examine the key decisions that shaped the manufacturer’s architecture and data maturity - Learn how the right partnership can accelerate implementation and support future scale - Review lessons learned while implementing a modern medallion architecture, governance model, and reporting ecosystem - Prepare for AI by building a scalable, future-ready data platform - Explore real-world successes, challenges, and recommendations for organizations considering Microsoft Fabric

sessions.title: The New Virtual Storefront: Autonomous Agents for Customer Self-Service
sessions.description: The customer service entry point is becoming a new kind of virtual storefront: always available, conversational, personalized, and capable of completing real work. This session explores how autonomous self-service agents can greet customers, understand intent, access business context, complete transactions, and escalate seamlessly when human help is needed. Attendees will learn how to design AI-powered self-service experiences that move beyond deflection toward meaningful resolution.

sessions.title: Using Copilot to Supercharge Business Central's Built-in CRM
sessions.description: Business Central’s CRM functionality offers a robust set of capabilities, including prospect and customer management, opportunities with defined steps and tasks, interactions, segments, and campaigns. The key question is how to streamline the integration of these capabilities with Outlook and our calendars. With Microsoft’s continued enhancements to Copilot, we can now use it to strengthen CRM functionality in Business Central. This session will demonstrate how Copilot can reduce manual effort and simplify calendar updates.

sessions.title: EXPO
Mining D365 F&SC Data with AI for Administration Wins
sessions.description: There's gold buried in your D365 Finance & Supply Chain data, you just need the right tools to find it. Utilizing AI can be your 'map' to finding and creating actionable insights easily! This session maps out how to use AI models to analyze administrative data and strike optimization gold. We'll start with an accessible overview of AI concepts and MCP servers, then sharpen your skills with prompt engineering techniques that turn vague questions into actionable insights. Next, we'll explore your excavation options: quick Excel exports for the impatient, custom console apps for the automation-minded, and MCP servers for the forward-thinking. Finally, we'll dig into real examples, unearthing inactive users from telemetry data, discovering role-less users and user-less roles, and calculating potential license savings (where the real $$$ can be saved). Whether you're an admin drowning in maintenance tasks or a consultant looking to deliver quick wins, this session hands you the treasure map, X marks the optimization.

sessions.title: Account Reconciliation Agent: Rethinking What's Possible?
sessions.description: Account reconciliation is evolving from a reactive, report-driven process into a proactive, AI-assisted experience. In this session, you'll discover how the new Account Reconciliation Workspace leverages intelligent agents to identify discrepancies, recommend corrective actions, and help finance teams resolve issues faster with greater confidence. Through real-world manufacturing scenarios, we'll demonstrate how AI can streamline reconciliation while maintaining transparency and control. Key takeaways include: -Explore the new Account Reconciliation Workspace and see how it shifts reconciliation from reactive SSRS reporting to a proactive, AI-driven workflow. -Learn how the Account Reconciliation Agent works by identifying voucher mismatches and recommending appropriate actions, such as creating journal entries, reversing transactions, linking records, or accepting transactions as-is. -See how built-in governance features like activity tracking, undo functionality, and agent recommendation dashboards provide transparency throughout the reconciliation process. -Understand the importance of data quality, and why maintaining clean, accurate financial data is essential to maximizing the effectiveness of AI-driven reconciliation.

sessions.title: AI with Purpose: Get people home safely. Reinventing a Traditional Business for the Age of AI
sessions.description: Organizations adopt AI to drive efficiency. We adopt AI to amplify our purpose. At Ramudden Global North America, we specialize in traffic management, safety infrastructure, and innovative urban traffic solutions that put safety, efficiency, and environmental responsibility first. We are a part of the global Ramudden network, with over 5,000 colleagues across 14 countries. Many think AI begins with Copilot or another AI tool. We learned it begins with ERP. Our original objective was straightforward: replace legacy systems with Microsoft BC. What emerged instead was something far more significant. Together with Microsoft and RSM, we're creating a frontier business built on embedded AI capabilities. Rather than deploying AI as isolated productivity tools, we are embedding intelligence directly into the way the business operates. Early results exceed expectations: 30–50% reduction in inventory reconciliation effort, 20–30% reduction in month-end activities, 50–70% faster AR, AP, and reporting. The most important outcome, however, is not technology. It is changing how people think. AI is no longer viewed as another IT initiative. It is becoming part of how we work as a business. This transformation is creating a repeatable blueprint. This session will share the governance model, implementation approach, adoption strategy, lessons learned, and measurable business outcomes behind turning an ERP implementation into an enterprise-wide AI transformation.

sessions.title: Are Your Agents Ready for the Real World? Lessons from Agentic ERP Adoption
sessions.description: Agents are moving from demos and pilots into real Finance and Supply Chain processes—but what does it actually take to get them adopted? Join fellow Dynamics 365 customers for an open roundtable on the realities of adopting agents in ERP. We’ll discuss where organizations are starting, which scenarios are gaining traction, what is slowing adoption, and how teams are thinking about trust, governance, security, human oversight, and measurable business value. Come ready to share what you’ve tried, what you’ve learned, and what questions you’re still working through. Whether you’re experimenting with your first agent or beginning to scale agentic experiences across Finance and Supply Chain, this is an opportunity to compare approaches, challenges, and lessons with peers navigating the same journey.

sessions.title: Business Central: Analytics and insights
sessions.description: Session highlight reporting and analytics, across the business to empower user with informed business decisions, including overview of multinational organizations capabilities.

sessions.title: Dynamics 365 FastTrack: Empowering Customers and Partners with AI-Powered Success by Design
sessions.description: Delivering a successful Dynamics 365 implementation takes more than choosing the right technology. Join Microsoft FastTrack to explore how AI-powered Success by Design is changing the way customers and partners approach solution delivery—from early design decisions to adoption and ongoing improvement. Discover implementation tools, reusable resources, and guidance that help teams address challenges earlier and make informed decisions throughout their projects. We’ll explore how to bring these capabilities into your existing delivery approach, strengthen collaboration between business and technical teams, and prepare for solutions where people and agents work together. Leave knowing which FastTrack resources to use, when to use them, and how to get started.

sessions.title: From Dispatch Board to Decision Board: Reimagining D365 Field Service Scheduling with Copilot
sessions.description: • Dispatchers at dealer networks juggle more than 40 unscheduled work orders a day across crews, territories, and service level agreements. Decisions that used to take 45 minutes now take under 6. • We built a Copilot-driven decision surface on the Dynamics 365 Field Service Schedule Board: natural language triage for incoming work orders, the Scheduling Operations Agent handling same day rebooking, and a custom Copilot Studio agent that pulls work order, ERP, and customer context into one answer instead of three screens. • In a live, on-stage demo, a dispatcher persona works through three escalating situations, a service level risk, a technician calling in sick, and a VIP customer call, resolved in real time with out of the box Copilot capabilities plus the custom agent layered on top. • Attendees leave with a reusable Dispatcher Copilot blueprint: the prompt patterns, the agent boundaries, and the governance guardrails proven in production.

sessions.title: LCS to PPAC: Preparing for Jan 2027 Deadline with a Real-World AI-Ready F&O Migration Playbook
sessions.description: February 16, 2026, marked a major shift for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: all new implementations must now be provisioned through the Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC), with Lifecycle Services (LCS) no longer supported for new projects. But this is more than a tooling change. In this technical deep dive, we share lessons learned from real-world customer projects, including both greenfield PPAC implementations and organizations modernizing their ALM strategy for 2026 and beyond. We explore changes to environment provisioning, Microsoft Entra security and administration, monitoring, capacity management, and project visibility. We also review modern ALM practices using unified deployment packages, Power Platform CLI, Azure DevOps pipelines, service principals, and Application Insights, while highlighting delivery processes that require redesign rather than a simple migration. This educational session focuses on practical, transferable lessons and Key Takeaways: The key differences between LCS and PPAC across environments, security, ALM, monitoring, and support. Common migration and implementation pitfalls and the strategies that successfully mitigated them. A practical PPAC readiness checklist covering governance, roles, and delivery processes. How PPAC and the Power Platform lay the foundation for Copilot, AI-driven operations, and future autonomous capabilities in F&O. A realistic roadmap for organizations planning implementations and migrations through 2027.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: AI and Agents Managing Complex Supply Chains and Procurement
sessions.description: Supply chains are more dynamic and unpredictable than ever. Discover how AI and agents in Microsoft Dynamics 365 help organizations anticipate disruptions, automate routine decisions, improve supplier collaboration, optimize inventory and fulfillment, and respond faster to changing business conditions. Through real-world scenarios and product innovations, see how organizations can move from reactive firefighting to proactive supply chain management, empowering teams to focus on strategic decisions while AI handles the operational complexity.

sessions.title: Scaling your sales team with Sales Development Agent
sessions.description: What if you can expand your addressable customer segments by scaling your sales team with always-on, autonomous proactive sales agents to generate new pipeline, ensure customer access and up-sell new products/services.

sessions.title: The Human + AI Workforce: Redefining the Agent Role
sessions.description: As autonomous agents take on more customer interactions, the role of the human agent is changing. sessions.title: The Predictive ERP: Using Business Central and AI to Ask “What If?”
sessions.description: What if you could test the impact of a business decision before making it? In this session, we’ll explore how Business Central and AI can move beyond reporting what already happened to help organizations model what could happen next. * What happens to cash flow if customers begin paying 10 days later? * How would margins and fulfillment be affected if a supplier increases prices or misses a critical delivery? * What happens to profitability if labor, freight, or material costs rise unexpectedly? * How would a sudden increase in demand affect inventory, capacity, and delivery commitments? The Predictive ERP gives leaders a new way to explore scenarios, understand tradeoffs, and make better decisions with greater confidence. This is not about replacing human judgment. It is about giving decision-makers the foresight to ask better questions, see around corners, and act before the business feels the impact.

sessions.title: From Clicks to Conversations: AI Agents Doing Real Work in D365 F&O
sessions.description: Copilot in D365 Finance & Operations has moved well past the chatbot phase, and the partners who understand where agents are right now will be the ones winning those conversations in 2026 and beyond. Drawing on a decade of corporate controller experience and real-world F&O delivery, presenter Bobbi Bricker brings a practitioner's lens to the agentic AI landscape. Carrie Butler bring the technical prowess as a developer, implementer and founder of the Microsoft Business Applications within Centric Consulting. Whether you're in pre-sales, delivery, or practice leadership, you'll leave this session with a clear picture of what to show clients, how to position the agent layer as a consulting opportunity, and what licensing and configuration conversations you need to be ready for.

sessions.description: Discover how Sales Qualification Agent helps sales teams identify, engage, and qualify high-potential leads faster using AI. Learn how organizations can automate research, personalize outreach, and prioritize opportunities, enabling sellers to focus on building relationships and closing deals while improving pipeline quality and sales productivity.

sessions.title: Ask Microsoft Anything: Dynamics 365 Contact Center Product AMA
sessions.description: This AMA-style roundtable gives attendees direct access to the Dynamics 365 Contact Center product team for an open discussion on product direction, customer scenarios, implementation considerations, AI-first service, supervisor experiences, quality management, human assist, autonomous agents, as well as CCaaS & CCAI integration patterns. Justin Coaxum will facilitate the discussion and route audience questions to the appropriate product experts in attendance. Participants will leave with practical answers, deeper product context, and a clearer understanding of how Microsoft is shaping the future of contact center experiences.

sessions.title: Bringing Customer Service into Microsoft 365 with Service Agent and Copilot Cowork
sessions.description: Customer service work no longer happens in a single application. Agents and supervisors spend their day across email, meetings, chat, documents, knowledge bases, and CRM systems. In this session, see how Service Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot brings customer data, cases, knowledge, and service actions directly into the flow of work, eliminating the need to switch between applications. Learn how Service Agent surfaces case insights, customer context, knowledge recommendations, and service actions across Microsoft 365, while Copilot Cowork enables users to delegate complex, multi-step service work that spans Dynamics 365, Outlook, Teams, meetings, and documents. Together, they create a new model for work where service professionals collaborate with AI to resolve issues faster, improve productivity, and deliver exceptional customer experiences

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Agentic Service to Delivery with Field Service
sessions.description: Follow a service request as agents triage, schedule, dispatch, helps technician in the field, and close it out across Field Service and ERP. See where agentic automation shortens time to resolution.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Intelligent Supply Chain Planning with AI
sessions.description: Discover how AI is transforming supply chain planning, starting with demand forecasting and extending to better planning decisions across the business. See how Dynamics 365 helps organizations improve forecast accuracy, respond faster to changing conditions, and equip planners with the insights needed to make more confident decisions. Learn how AI can help reduce planning effort, improve agility, and support a more connected planning process from forecast to execution.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Personalized Employee Self-Service, Powered by D365 HR & Workforce Intelligence
sessions.description: See how Dynamics 365 HR, business skills, the MCP server, and Workforce App Intelligence deliver hyper-personalized employee self-service.

sessions.title: Microsoft Presents: Service-Centric Agentic Order to Cash
sessions.description: Watch agents drive order, invoicing, and collections with fewer handoffs and faster cash. See where automation pays off first in your O2C cycle.

sessions.title: Scaling Dynamics 365 Across Dealers: How Caterpillar Standardized Transformation Across Multiple SIs
sessions.description: Large-scale business transformation programs often involve multiple implementation partners, regional variations, and evolving business requirements. Maintaining consistency across these environments can become one of the biggest barriers to success. In this customer-led case study, Caterpillar will share how it established a more standardized and repeatable approach for dealer transformations built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Mavim. The session will explore how Caterpillar creates alignment across multiple systems integrators by establishing a common foundation for process design, requirements management, fit-gap decisions, governance, release planning, and AI readiness initiatives. With Caterpillar, Mavim will discuss how process governance, traceability, and implementation visibility help organizations scale transformation efforts across diverse ecosystems. Attendees will learn how Caterpillar connects enterprise standards, dealer-specific requirements, implementation governance, and modernization initiatives to reduce rework, improve collaboration, manage localized variations, and create a more scalable foundation for future AI-enabled business processes. This session is ideal for organizations managing complex Dynamics 365 deployments across multiple business units, regions, implementation partners, or franchise/dealer networks.

sessions.title: Statements That Speak: Reinventing Financial Reporting with AI and Copilot
sessions.description: The financial statement has looked essentially the same for a century: rows, columns, and a story locked inside numbers that few outside finance can read. AI is finally changing that. This session explores a modern twist on financial reporting — where Copilot and generative AI turn static statements into living, explainable narratives that answer "why" as readily as "what." We'll look at how finance teams are moving beyond the month-end scramble: AI that drafts variance commentary in plain language, surfaces the drivers behind a number, and lets a CFO interrogate the P&L by simply asking. We'll also confront the hard part — the controls, auditability, and data governance that separate a genuine advance from a compliance risk, and why trustworthy financials demand a human firmly in the loop. Attendees leave with a grounded view of where AI adds real value across the reporting cycle, the guardrails that keep automated insight audit-ready, and a practical sense of where a modern finance function should begin.

sessions.title: Transforming Commercial Vehicle Registration with AI in Dynamics CE
sessions.description: Commercial vehicle registration programs rely on large volumes of documentation, creating significant administrative burden, manual data entry, and processing delays. This session explores how the Idaho DMV leveraged AI-powered document intelligence within Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement to modernize and automate critical registration workflows. Using Azure AI Document Intelligence and Dynamics 365, the solution automatically classifies incoming documents, extracts key registration data, validates business rules, and routes information directly into business processes. The result is reduced manual effort, improved data accuracy, faster transaction processing, and a better customer experience. Through this real-world customer story, attendees will learn how AI-driven document processing was implemented within a government environment, including the business challenges addressed, solution architecture, governance considerations, implementation lessons learned, and measurable outcomes. The session will also demonstrate how AI-generated metadata can drive automation and support future AI and Copilot initiatives. Participants will leave with practical strategies for integrating document intelligence into Dynamics 365, modernizing document-centric processes, and delivering tangible business value through AI-powered automation.

sessions.title: Your ERP Just Got AI Developers: X++ Development with MCP, Agents & Zero Patience for Manual Work
sessions.description: Still manually translating requirements, arguing about fit/gap, writing X++ line by line, compiling, fixing errors, deploying, testing… and repeating until morale drops? Cute. In this session, we’ll show how Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations development evolves when you bring in an MCP server and a squad of AI agents that actually do the work. A requirement lands in Azure DevOps, and instead of becoming your next headache, it gets picked up by an orchestrator that delegates everything—summarization, architecture decisions, fit/gap analysis, design, development, deployment, and even testing. Watch AI agents dig through standard and custom D365FO code, challenge assumptions (yes, really), generate designs you can argue with, and then go ahead and implement them anyway—creating tables, classes, forms, and extensions via X++ without touching XML like it’s 2012. They compile, fix their own mistakes (must be nice), deploy to real environments, and validate the solution like a functional consultant who never gets tired. If something breaks? No drama. The agents loop, fix, redeploy, retest—until everything works and you’re left wondering what exactly you’re supposed to do now. Welcome to AI-powered ERP development, where your biggest role might just be approving things and pretending you always trusted the process.

sessions.title: Accelerate Your CRM Transformation: A Hands-On Workshop with Dynamics 365 Activate
sessions.description: Moving to a new CRM should be more than a data migration. In this workshop, participants will explore how Dynamics 365 Activate can help simplify the journey to Dynamics 365 and create a foundation for broader sales and service transformation. Through practical scenarios, we’ll examine the migration journey, key considerations, and how organizations can approach modernization with greater confidence.

sessions.title: Bring Your Scenario: Guided Agent Development Lab
sessions.description: Do you have a business problem in mind but need a practical way to turn it into an agent? Bring a scenario to this half-day guided lab and work with the Microsoft team to shape your approach. We'll evaluate whether a Dynamics 365 agent template fits your scenario and can speed up your build, or whether a custom approach makes more sense. Along the way, you'll identify where human review and fallback steps are needed. Business process owners, makers, consultants, and architects will leave with hands-on experience and practical guidance for turning ideas into action.

sessions.title: Building Enterprise Extensions for Sales Agent
sessions.description: Every organization has unique business processes, knowledge sources, and enterprise applications. The real value of Sales Agent comes from extending it to work within those existing systems while preserving a unified seller experience. In this workshop, you'll learn how organizations enhance Sales Agent with custom business skills, contextual knowledge experiences, and integrations that connect sellers to the information and actions they need. We will explore practical scenarios such as routing users to the appropriate SharePoint knowledge repositories based on business context, integrating ServiceNow workflows, and bringing proprietary systems into Sales Agent through custom tools and extensibility patterns. You'll also learn how business skills can provide process-specific guidance, standardize best practices, and help sellers navigate complex business processes directly within Sales Agent. Attendees will learn: How to extend Sales Agent with custom business skills and enterprise-specific capabilities SharePoint routing patterns for delivering contextual knowledge experiences Approaches for integrating ServiceNow and other enterprise systems How to surface organization-specific processes and actions within Sales Agent Best practices for maintaining a unified seller experience while supporting diverse business requirements

sessions.title: Contact Center + CCAI Lab: Real-Time Voice Agents and HumanAssist for Contact Center
sessions.description: What makes a voice-to-human handoff feel like one conversation rather than a restart? In this half-day Contact Center and CCAI lab, work through a synthetic service enquiry spanning a real-time voice-agent scenario and a representative-side HumanAssist workflow. Map the information that should travel with the interaction, define where people retain control, and test normal handling, escalation, and fallback paths. Compare expected and observed behavior to identify gaps in context continuity and the representative experience. Designed for service operations owners, architects, and implementation partners, this guided workshop turns workflow design into focused testing. Leave with a voice-flow map, an escalation and context checklist, a three-scenario test plan, and an action plan for the next implementation steps.

sessions.title: Dynamics 365 Activate for Customer Engagement Apps: Streamlining Implementations
sessions.description: Explore what it takes to move from Salesforce to Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service in this half-day, hands-on lab. Using a prepared scenario, work with Dynamics 365 Activate to assess the source environment, uncover migration complexity, and turn discovery findings into an actionable plan. Learn how Dynamics 365 Activate can automate and streamline migration and implementation complexities. Leave with practical experience and a clearer understanding of the decisions behind a successful migration.

sessions.title: Dynamics Activate for ERP: From Business Process to Validated Implementation
sessions.description: Explore what it takes to move from SAP to Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations in this half-day, hands-on lab. Using a prepared scenario, work with Dynamics 365 Activate to assess the source environment, uncover migration complexity, and turn discovery findings into an actionable plan. Learn how Dynamics 365 Activate can automate and streamline migration and implementation complexities. Leave with practical experience and a clearer understanding of the decisions behind a successful ERP migration.

sessions.title: Inside the Agentic Contact Center
sessions.description: The Hands-on Lab Session provides practical, interactive experience with Contact Center Intelligence (CCI), conversational orchestration, observability, and agentic diagnostics. Participants explore a range of lab modules focused on contact center solutions and service agents; HAA (Human Assist Agent) and QAA (Quality Assurance Agent), emphasizing agent assistance and quality monitoring; and Conversation Orchestration, which covers the integration and coordination of conversational components. The session also introduces App + OTEL Insights for observability and instrumentation, Agentic Diagnostics + Journey Viz for diagnostics and customer journey visualization, and Contact Center Intelligence (CCI) scenario labs for applying concepts to practical use cases. Additionally, the optional Embed SDK + Test Simulation module enables participants to explore SDK integration and simulation-based testing. Overall, the lab session aims to bridge theoretical knowledge and hands-on implementation, enabling participants to understand, integrate, monitor, and troubleshoot AI-powered contact center workflows while gaining practical exposure to agent-based solutions and end-to-end customer experience orchestration.

sessions.title: Microsoft Workshop: Build and deploy cowork use cases in your organization today
sessions.description: Turn recurring ERP work into practical Copilot Cowork use cases. In this hands-on workshop, identify a high-value process, design the workflow, connect the required apps, documents, and data, and build a deployment plan. Leave with a working pattern you can adapt and launch in your organization.

sessions.title: Microsoft Workshop: Hands-on with the Dynamics 365 Commerce MCP Server
sessions.description: Get hands-on with the Dynamics 365 Commerce MCP Server. In guided labs, you'll connect agents to Commerce and work through the agentic shopping journey: product discovery, store inventory, pricing and promotions, cart and coupons, delivery, Pay by Link checkout, and order history. Along the way, you'll see how each MCP tool responds and how agents put tools together to complete a task. Bring a laptop and leave with working examples.

sessions.title: Microsoft Workshop: Hands-on with the NEW Rental Management module
sessions.description: Learn the fundamentals of the new Rental Management module. This session will explore the end-to-end rental lifecycle, including fleet items, rental quotes, reservations and contracts, fleet item movements, check-in and check-out processes, rental contract invoicing, and the supporting setup and configuration. We’ll also look beyond the core module to discuss Field Service work order/Project Operations integration, APIs, and extensibility, along with demonstrations of how MCP and Cowork can unlock agentic Rental Management business scenarios.

sessions.title: Microsoft Workshop: Solve business process challenges using Dynamics 365 ERP MCP
sessions.description: Roll up your sleeves and use Dynamics 365 ERP MCP to solve real business process challenges in a guided, hands-on environment. Bring a laptop and leave with working examples.

sessions.title: Workshop: Build a Personalized Insights-to-Action Experience with Account 360 and Contact 360
sessions.description: In this hands-on workshop you'll build a personalized insights-to-action experience with Account 360 and Contact 360 in a Public Preview lab environment. You'll use the semantic model and business skills to ground insights in your own tables and terminology, author a custom insight by describing it in a sentence, and publish an Account 360 page to a sales team. Then you'll open the account as a seller, see your insight in context and review a suggested next step before anything is sent or saved. We'll close with an update on account-based marketing in Customer Insights - Journeys, including buying groups and account-level engagement, and how sales and marketing can work from the same account foundation.

sessions.title: Workshop: Configuring Agents for Dynamics 365 Customer Service
sessions.description: Learn how to configure and operate Customer Intent Agent, Case Management Agent, Knowledge Management Agent and Quality Evaluation Agent
